name: Sovereign Resident Source Refresh
purpose: Refresh the already-local canonical sovereign WorkerCoordinator/runtime source at the beginning of every callable runtime invocation, preserving mutable runtime state and emitting authentic refresh or boundary evidence without creating an always-on runtime source or a new runtime owner.
trigger: every invocation of a consuming callable sovereign runtime before that runtime is used
scope: one invocation-bound already-local canonical source root refreshed into one invocation-bound sovereign runtime root
reuse_instructions: Invoke this reusable task for every callable runtime use before downstream runtime work. Do not treat runtime source freshness as persistent or always-on state. The reusable adapter delegates to scripts/refresh_sovereign_worker_runtime_source.py and additionally guarantees materialization of the neutral reusable scheduler runner and contract needed by downstream reusable scheduling. Runtime availability is an execution boundary of the invocation, not a standing source-state prerequisite. Do not create another source refresher, runtime owner, scheduler, credential route, or source transport.
